 By 
 Victoria McDonnell 
 Published

 If there’s one thing I’ve learned from diving headfirst into the world of K-beauty, it’s that achieving that coveted glass-skin glow is about more than just having a 10-step skincare routine. 
 Sometimes, it comes down to one surprisingly simple product — and according to Biodance founder Mihwa Kim, that product is a face mist.
 I recently had the pleasure of sitting down with Kim, who flew all the way from South Korea, to talk about K-beauty. Over a cappuccino and an iced latte, with a translator helping us bridge the language gap, we chatted about everything from Korean skincare philosophies to the products she considers absolute must-haves. Naturally, I was all ears.
 When we started comparing American and Korean skincare routines, one difference immediately stood out: the importance of hydration throughout the day. While American routines often focus on cleansing, treating and moisturizing in the morning and evening, Korean skincare takes a more continuous approach to keeping skin hydrated.
 In fact, when I asked Kim what she considers essential, her answer was refreshingly straightforward: a mist is “essential and non-negotiable.”
 Biodance Collagen Peptides Jelly Serum Mist 
 Amazon 
 Enter the Biodance Collagen Peptides Jelly Serum Mist , a $17 skincare staple that might just change the way you think about your daily routine. Rather than treating face mist as an occasional refresher or an unnecessary extra, Kim sees it as an integral part of maintaining healthy, hydrated-looking skin.
 And truthfully? I’m sold.
 BUY NOW $19.00 $16.99 
 The beauty of this mist is its versatility. You can spritz it onto freshly cleansed skin before applying makeup, layer it into your existing skincare routine or reach for it sporadically throughout the day whenever your complexion needs a little pick-me-up. Think of it as your Korean skincare cheat code for keeping skin hydrated, plump and dewy from morning until night.
 We’re talking about that fresh, juicy complexion that looks moisturized rather than greasy. No tightness, no flaky patches, no cracked-looking skin and no emphasizing unwanted texture. Just a healthy-looking glow that makes you look like you’ve been drinking all your water and getting eight hours of sleep (even when you haven’t).
 Of course, our conversation didn’t stop at face mist. We also discussed Biodance’s lineup of sheet masks , all of which I’ve personally reviewed in detail. As someone who has spent plenty of time testing and writing about the brand, getting to speak directly with the woman behind it felt like meeting my ultimate K-beauty icon.
 I walked away with a newfound appreciation for the Korean approach to skincare: Hydration isn’t something you check off your to-do list once in the morning, it’s something you maintain. And if a $17 mist is the secret to making that happen, consider me officially converted.

 What is Biodance Collagen Peptides Jelly Serum Mist, and what does it do?
 It’s a 2-in-1 sprayable hydrogel mist and serum designed to enhance elasticity, tighten pores and provide 24-hour hydration for a dewy finish.
 How does the Jelly-to-Mist spray mechanism work?
 The solid hydrogel formula breaks into fine micro-gel droplets upon pumping, adhering smoothly to skin without dripping or evaporating quickly.
 How do you apply it as a face mist versus a concentrated serum?
 Spray 8 inches away for an even face mist or setting spray. Hold closer to the skin and pat gently for a concentrated serum application.
 What are the key active ingredients?
 It features 77% ultra-low molecular weight collagen water, a 10-signal peptide complex, hydrolyzed hyaluronic acid , niacinamide , adenosine and galactomyces ferment filtrate.
 Can it be applied over makeup throughout the day?
 Yes, spraying from eight or more inches away refreshes skin and adds glow over makeup without smudging foundation.
